description: A script implementing a speed typing game with features like word display, timing, scoring, and difficulty level adjustment.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the game, sets up the first word, and starts countdown and status checks.

methods.name: showWord
methods.description: Displays a random word from the list.

methods.name: countdown
methods.description: Decrements the timer and updates the display; ends game when time runs out.

methods.name: checkStatus
methods.description: Checks if the game is over and updates the message accordingly.

methods.name: startMatch
methods.description: Handles user input; updates score and displays new word on correct match.

methods.name: changeLevel
methods.description: Adjusts game difficulty level and resets relevant variables.
